Normalize email; transactionally create unverified identity and CITIZEN membership only for enabled utility. Duplicate registration returns generic Message without changing an existing password, identity or grants. Coalesce verification delivery under account/IP limits; no authenticated session issued.

Validate current credentials and rate limits on every attempt. Revoke prior presented preauth/authenticated session and rotate session plus CSRF. Never cache or reissue Set-Cookie or a previously issued secret. A lost reply requires fresh CSRF bootstrap and credential validation; any unreachable session expires normally. Revocation is monotonic. Serialize session issuance with password reset/account suspension; recheck current credential version and user state at commit so in-flight old-password login cannot survive reset.

Generic Message whether account exists or not. Coalesce delivery during cooldown; rate-limit IP and normalized account, never return or retrieve an existing token. Outside cooldown a new bounded token invalidates prior unused reset tokens. Store only token verifier; no authenticated session issued.

Atomically consume unexpired purpose-bound token once, update password hash and revoke all authenticated sessions. No automatic login. Consumed/expired/invalid token returns uniform 422, including after a lost successful reply; retry by login or new recovery, never cached success or secret.

Atomically consume purpose-bound email token once and activate only the pending verified identity/allowed citizen membership. No authenticated session or new role grant. Consumed/expired/invalid token returns uniform 422; check account status through login or request bounded support recovery after lost reply.
